subject: Proposal: bucketed-reserve-structure & approval path for Halcyon Health
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evan Torres <evan@halcyonhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: bucketed-reserve-structure & approval path for Halcyon Health

Hi Ben / Laura —

Following today's call with Evan, attached is a compact proposal for a bucketed reserved-capacity commitment that maps to Halcyon Health's seasonal usage spikes. Key points up front:

- Core ask: 120 reserved vGPU-equivalents for 12 months, with two optional purchase windows (Q4 & Q1) to add up to +40 vGPU-eq.
- Pricing sensitivity: we modeled 3 GPU price scenarios (base / +15% / +30%) and included a discount ladder tied to commit bands.
- Risk-sharing proposal: if market GPU costs increase >20% we offer a partial indexation fallback that protects Halcyon's spend while preserving unit economics via a stepped credit pool.

Attachments: reserve_bucket_model_v2.xlsx (scenario tab + unit economics) and a short discount_approval_matrix.pdf for sign-off routes.

Ask: Ben, can you confirm the governance route we should follow for a mid-deal discretionary discount (targeting up to 18% in top band)? Laura — would you review the attached approval matrix and confirm finance guardrails (minimum gross margin thresholds) we need to keep? Evan — tagging you for visibility; we can walk through the numbers tomorrow if useful.

Next steps I propose:
1) Internal approval checklist (Ben + Laura) by EOD Fri 7/20
2) Shared readout with Halcyon on Mon 7/23 (30 min) to lock in commit windows and escalation path

Thanks,

Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.ai
(attachment: reserve_bucket_model_v2.xlsx - workbook, discount_approval_matrix.pdf - one-pager)

From: Evan Torres <evan@halcyonhealth.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Jul 2028 11:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Proposal: bucketed-reserve-structure & approval path for Halcyon Health

Thanks, Stephanie —

Overall this looks promising. A few clarifying points from procurement:
- We need a mechanism so our OPEX forecasts don't blow out if GPU spot prices spike. The stepped credit pool you mentioned sounds reasonable; can you confirm it applies only to inference tokens and not training workloads?
- Can you provide an explicit cap on the maximum price pass-through in any 30-day window? Our CFO wants a worst-case exposure number.
- On the optional windows: Halcyon prefers the right (but not obligation) to expand in Q4 only; a second window may be fine but needs to be cheaper per-unit than the first optional add-on.

Happy to review the workbook with you on Monday. If you can sketch the worst-case exposure row in the spreadsheet, that will help expedite our legal review.

—Evan
Evan Torres
Head of Procurement, Halcyon Health
evan@halcyonhealth.com

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Jul 2028 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: bucketed-reserve-structure & approval path for Halcyon Health

Stephanie — good framing. A couple internal notes before we respond to Evan:

- Discount ceiling: I can approve up to 12% off list for committed base bands, subject to a minimum 28% gross margin. Anything above that requires director-level sign-off (Marcus/VP). We should surface the rationale (CAD: usage certainty + multi-quarter visibility).
- Indexation/fallback: Finance will tolerate a capped pass-through model but only if we have a pre-funded credit escrow to protect Redwood on the first 10% of delta. Laura — can you confirm whether a credit pool equal to 1.5% of committed ARR is acceptable?
- Optional windows: I agree with Evan that the first opt-window should be less expensive than the second; propose we make Q4 add-on at -3% off base price and Q1 at parity or -1% depending on band. Keeps incentives for earlier expansion.

I've attached the approval matrix I drafted (see discount_approval_matrix.pdf). If Laura signs off on the credit-pool sizing we can table the director approval and present a clean offer.

Action items:
- Laura: confirm credit pool percentage / margin floor by EOD today (7/20)
- Stephanie: add worst-case 30-day exposure line to the spreadsheet and re-share
- Karthik: flag this to solutions-eng for a quick note on how optional add-ons will be routed to capacity pools (we need to ensure we don't over-allocate to dedicated nodes)

Ben Carter
Head of Sales, Enterprise Accounts
ben@redwood.ai

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Jul 2028 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: bucketed-reserve-structure & approval path for Halcyon Health

Thanks — I reviewed the matrix and the model. Quick answers:

- Credit pool: finance accepts a pre-funded credit escrow equal to 1.5% of committed ARR to absorb the first band of GPU cost delta. This preserves our minimum margin target.
- Margin floor: 28% gross margin floor is acceptable for the base commit band. Above that (for any concession >12%) we'll route to director approval.
- 30-day cap: We can set a maximum pass-through of +25% in any rolling 30-day window, with that exposure limited by the credit escrow on the first 10% and an executive review trigger thereafter.

Given that, Ben — you have delegated authority to approve up to 12% discounts on this deal. If we push to 15-18% we need written director approval and a short memo tying the concession to strategic value (logo, multi-year reference, or pipeline pull-through).

Stephanie — go ahead and add the worst-case exposure row to the spreadsheet and update the slides for Monday's readout. Evan — we'll incorporate these guardrails into the formal offer and mark the optional windows per your preference (Q4 primary expansion). Happy to join the Monday conversation if useful (I can be there for the finance minute).

Laura Bennett
Director, Finance — Enterprise Deals
laura@redwood.ai
(attachment: discount_approval_matrix.pdf - signed)
